title: Tip distribution
intro: Tip distribution calculates how pooled tips for a shift should be split across staff using configured weights, then saves an official distribution record. Managers often use the same screen from Tip distribution in the sidebar.

sections.title: Tip distribution screen
steps: Tap Tip distribution in the sidebar.
Select a shift and business date at the top.
Load tips calculates totals from paid orders in that shift window.
sections.caption: Tip distribution screen.

sections.title: Shift and date
steps: Choose the shift from the dropdown.
Pick the date — cannot be in the future.
Tap Load tips to fetch tip totals and build the distribution table.
sections.caption: Shift, date, and load controls.

sections.title: Distribution table
steps: Total tips shows the pooled amount for the shift.
Each row lists user, role, weight, and calculated share.
Submit saves the distribution after you review the shares.
sections.caption: Totals and per-user distribution table.
